SELECT s.id, s.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, s.sku_id, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, s.goods_id, g.goods_code, g.goods_name, u.unit_name, sku.spec_info, s.quantity, s.cost_price, sku.purchase_price, sku.sale_price, sku.wholesale_price, (s.quantity * s.cost_price) AS amount, s.update_time FROM wms_stock s LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN wms_goods_sku sku ON s.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN wms_goods g ON s.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN wms_unit u ON sku.unit_id = u.id WHERE 1=1
AND s.warehouse_id = #{reqVO.warehouseId}
AND g.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.goodsCode}, '%')
AND g.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.goodsName}, '%')
AND sku.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.skuCode}, '%')
AND s.quantity < 10
ORDER BY s.update_time DESC
